name: 会話検索と絞り込み
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE Lighthouse component LH03-0037「会話検索と絞り込み」.
Reference priority: Image 1 ORIGINAL controls magnifying-glass and plus geometry, optical stroke, filter proportions and selected state. Image 2 Japanese mock is secondary for exact localized copy, locked typography and logical390x110 layout. Fix its mint unselected chips and omitted plus enclosure. Image 3 is approved white/forest-green styling only.
Two compact rows. Top: white search input358x40 at16,8, subtle neutral outline and12px corners. Original slender slate magnifying glass at left, exact placeholder「会話を検索」in Meiryo Regular14px/24px, tracking0, quiet gray. Empty unfocused state; no caret, AI feature, microphone or extra control.
Bottom: exactly four filter pills in one row, height32, exact labels「すべて」「未読」「お気に入り」「グループ」in Meiryo Regular12px/16px tracking0, centered and single line. Preserve ALL selected and other three unselected. Selected「すべて」has smooth restrained forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E and white REGULAR label. Other three are WHITE with fine neutral borders and slate labels. Preserve native widths60/58/96/88 and gaps8 where practical, no wrapping or clipping.
At far right restore ORIGINAL small white outlined rounded pill/circle enclosing its simple slate PLUS. Mock's bare plus omitted this enclosure. Keep same center/right alignment and source thin optical weight. This plus is a fifth control, not another text filter. No badges, selected check, extra filters or icons.
Accent decision: source pale-green All communicates actual selection. Adapt that selected pill only to forest-green gradient; keep unselected filters and search white. Supporting search/plus glyphs coherent slate#526173. No mint wash or random icon colors.
Purewhite#FFFFFF canvas. One complete compact component prominent on landscape3:2 with modest margins. Exclude Chats heading, top camera/add buttons, chat list, footer, AI bubble, phone and background app. Preserve Japanese text, source fine details and native font roles. Static raster candidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像を検索/追加の形・追加外枠・すべて選択状態の主参照、モックを日本語とRegular14/24・12/16の副参照。生成出力を目視し会話を検索と4項目全文・すべてだけ選択・未選択3白面・囲まれた追加記号・整列/欠落なしを確認。意味のある選択だけ森林緑、補助記号スレート、ミント未選択面を白へ。AI機能や追加要素なし。厳密字体/色/記号計測・検索/絞込/追加実動作・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
